meta.name: captain-release
meta.description: Captain-only. Quality-check, commit, push, create PR, and cut a release in one flow. The "code is ready" command for captain-owned branches. Every PR is a release. Formerly `/release` — v2 rename to captain-actor-verb.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键执行代码质检、提交、建PR并发布版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速将代码从分支发布为正式版本
copy.tagline_en: Run quality checks, commit, push, create PR, and cut a release in one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn ready code into a release

howto.what: 装上后，当你对 captain 所属分支执行命令时，Claude 会依次进行代码质量检查、提交、推送、创建 PR 并更新版本号，最终生成一份发布摘要。
howto.when: 当你使用 /captain-release 命令并给出提交描述时触发。前提是你当前在 captain-* 分支、不在 master、有未提交的变更且已完成质量门禁检查。

say.text: 执行发布流程，提交信息为“修复配置错误”。
say.note: Claude 会完成全流程并输出摘要。

say.text: 只提交和推送，不创建 PR：--no-pr 发布。
say.note: Claude 会跳过 PR 创建步骤。

say.text: 先检查质量门禁，再运行发布。
say.note: Claude 在开始前会检查 QG 收据。

howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude runs a complete release flow: quality gate check, commit, push, create a pull request, bump version, and output a summary. Works only on captain-owned branches.
howto.when_en: Triggered by using the /captain-release command with a commit description. Must be on a captain-* branch, not master, with staged changes and a valid QG receipt.

say_en.text: Run release flow with commit message 'Fix config error'.
say_en.note: Claude executes full flow and prints summary.

say_en.text: Commit and push only, no PR: --no-pr release.
Check quality gate first, then run release.
say_en.note: Claude checks QG receipt before proceeding.
